Below the title, there is a smaller line of text indicating the source: "IGN VIA: DEADLINE." The central figure in the image is a man standing on what appears to be a dock or pier by the sea. He is dressed in a light pink shirt with a white collar, a light-colored tie, and a beige jacket draped over his shoulders. He is also wearing sunglasses and holding a small object
